profile.description:
The profile for API operations. If not set, the default profile
created with `aws configure` will be used.

region.description:
The region where AWS operations will take place. Examples
are us-east-1, us-west-2, etc.

external_id.description: A unique identifier that might be required when you assume a role in another account.

role_arn.description: Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of an IAM Role to assume prior to making API calls.

session_name.description: An identifier for the assumed role session.

block.description:
The *emrstreaming* provider offers continuous deployment functionality for streaming steps into an EMR cluster. Use the provider to manage EMR steps via terraform.
You must configure the provider with the proper credentials before you can use it. The configuration options for the provider are identical to the terraform-aws-provider without the support for access_key and secret_key authentication

cluster_id.description: A unique string that identifies a cluster.

id.description: Step id a unique string that identifies the step on a cluster.

force_redeploy.description: Force to always re-deploy step regardless of the current status

args.description: A list of command line arguments to pass to the step.

jar.description: A path to a JAR file run during the step.

main_class.description: The name of the main class in the specified Java file.

properties.description: A list of Java properties that are set when the step runs. You can use these properties to pass key value pairs to your main function.

health_check_monitor_period.description: A period of time in seconds to monitor the submitted job to become RUNNING

pre_shutdown_wait_period.description: A period of time in seconds to wait before cancelling the job. Use this parameter when utilizing your own shutdown approach

shutdown_timeout.description: A timeout value in seconds for a job to become cancelled

status.description: The current status of the step, should be RUNNING for successfully submitted jobs

step.description: A step to be deployed to the cluster.

block.description: The resource *emrstreaming_step* adds a step to an existing EMR cluster. This resource is designed to submit streaming jobs that supposed to continuously run on a permanent EMR cluster.The *emrstreaming_step* acts as a continuous deployment resource to manage jobs lifecycle on an EMR cluster.A step in any status except RUNNING will be marked for replacement
